result.title: CAGE-NAS: Certified Functional Descent for Efficient Model Growth
result.comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at AXIOM 2026: Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning (NeurIPS 2026 Workshop)
result.summary: The progressive growth of neural networks requires deciding when the current representation remains sufficient for optimization and when it should be expanded. CAGE-NAS formulates this decision in function space through an admissibility criterion on approximations of the functional gradient. As long as a representation enables a certified Functional Gradient Descent step, the architecture remains fixed; when the criterion fails, a function-preserving expansion is applied and the resulting representation is evaluated again. As the main instance, we study the family induced by the tangent space, using a regularized projection of the functional gradient. In a controlled setting with exact certification, CAGE-NAS produces architectures positioned above the 99.8th performance percentile by held-out RMSE among all admissible alternatives within the same parameter budget, without enumerating them during the growth trajectory.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 CAGE-NAS，把网络何时扩张的决策放到函数空间中，用泛函梯度近似上的可容许性准则判断当前表示是否仍支持经验证的泛函梯度下降步，不满足时做保函数扩张并重新评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「表示是否足够、何时扩张」的认证式判据与 LVR 中动态计算和停止/扩展决策有概念联系；但摘要未涉及多模态或 latent 推理，是否可迁移到 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益-成本权衡仍需核查。
